document.purpose: Compare punch machine vs laser machine cutting on VP molds #4 and #7 for bending NG.

conclusions.topic: Punch vs Laser cutting by mold
conclusions.normalized_interpretation: Mold #4: Punch 41.58% vs Laser 65.98% = 0.630x, 37.0% improved by punch. Mold #7: Punch 10% vs Laser 30.93% = 0.323x, 67.7% improved by punch. Punch consistently produces less VP bending than laser; mold #7 is much better than #4 in both machines.

suggested_checks.check_item: Prefer punch over laser for VP cutting (mold #4, #7)
suggested_checks.reason: Punch reduces bending NG 37-68% vs laser on both molds.

suggested_checks.check_item: Use mold #7 over mold #4 where possible
suggested_checks.reason: Mold #7 NG far lower than mold #4 in both punch and laser.

limitations: No Normal baseline; only 100 pcs per combination.
